final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT t.ordertypedist AS mix, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON a.translink = t.transreg GROUP BY t.ordertypedist), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.mix AS mix, s1.cnt AS cnt, CAST(s1.cnt AS REAL) / s2.total AS ratio FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.total IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM s3), s5 AS (SELECT s3.mix AS mix, s3.cnt AS cnt, s3.ratio AS ratio, s4.avg_ratio AS avg_ratio FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL) SELECT mix, cnt, ratio, ratio - avg_ratio FROM s5 WHERE ratio > avg_ratio
